title: Editor freezes when tileset texture region set to 1px, difficult to recover from
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible: v4.4.1.stable.mono.official [49a5bc7b6]
Reproducible: v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
Reproducible: v4.5.beta1.official [46c495ca2]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1255U (12 threads)

### Issue description

I was editing a scene when I noticed the editor getting slugish, I switched to the main scene and went to check on the tilemaplayers as I had just converted them from a tilemap, they were fine before they went from 390px x 390px to 1px x 1px not sure what did it. when I selected the tileset tab in the editor, it got really slow and unusable, cpu usage spiked.

I expected to be able to recover from within the editor, even opening in recovering mode and open the tileset froze the editor.

To fix the tileset I manually edited the tileset resource file in editor setting it back to the correct texture region size.

Log from systemd journal: Godot did not output to stdout when I ran it from the commandline only realised it was going to the journal because the journal process cpu usage spiked, the journal log was flooded.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a project.
2. Create a tileset.
3. Add a tileset source.
4. Set texture region to 1px. (In the MRP, even the default setting of 16px has some performance issues)
    
   The editor freezes when setting up the tileset resource even before a default scene is created.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[tileseteditorfreezemrp-1px.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20998232/tileseteditorfreezemrp-1px.zip)
